title: Stimulation model: does optogenetic perturbation change coupling (kappa)?
question: Does closed-loop optogenetic stimulation change Purkinje-cell coupling (scalar kappa in the pulse window), or only firing rates?
headline: Inconclusive. Null-corrected kappa_pulse - kappa_control = -0.24 (90% CI -0.44 to -0.03; Wilcoxon p=0.070, FDR 0.14; not equivalent to 0 within +-0.3, n=21). No change in multi-information (p=0.97). Depends on control window and cohort.
